name: zoo
description: A shared world where each creature runs model-written code in a Durable Object facet.

scripts.check: bun run types && tsc -p tsconfig.json && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.web.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.lint: git submodule update --init --quiet tools/anti-slop && biome check . && oxlint
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run lint && bun run copy-check && bun run test
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler deploy -c core/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy
